label: Medical waste and sharps
summary: Used needles, scalpels, blood, body fluids, medical waste, sewage and human or animal remains can carry hepatitis, HIV, tetanus and gut infections. Hospitals, clinics, nursing homes, pharmacies and abandoned homes all have them.
signs: Yellow or red bins and bags, often with the biohazard symbol
Sewage, overflowing toilets and standing dirty water
Dead animals or human remains; flies and a sweet rotten smell
Mouse or rat droppings, nests and urine stains, especially in closed-up rooms, sheds, cabins and vehicles
do: Wear thick gloves and pick up needles with pliers or tongs
Drop needles point-first into a hard plastic bottle with a screw lid
Assume all blood and body fluid is infectious
Wash hands with soap and water after any contact, even with gloves on
Keep sewage and remains well away from water sources
Leave remains alone, or move them only with gloves, a mask and help
Air out rooms with rodent droppings for 30 minutes, then soak droppings and nests with 1 part bleach to 10 parts water for 5 minutes and wipe up with gloves; never sweep or vacuum them dry
dont: Don't reach blindly into bins, bags, drawers or between cushions
Don't recap, bend or break needles
Don't eat or drink in contaminated rooms
ppe: Nitrile gloves, with thick gloves over them for rough work. No glove stops a needle: pick sharps up with pliers or tongs
Goggles or a face shield against splashes; safety glasses don’t keep splashes out
An N95 or better for dust from droppings; a half mask with P100 filters for a heavy rodent mess
firstAid: Needle stick or cut: let it bleed freely and wash with soap and running water; don't suck or scrub it
Blood or fluid in eyes or mouth: rinse with plenty of clean water
Get medical help as soon as you can: medicine to prevent HIV has to start within 72 hours, and sooner is better
Watch any wound for redness, swelling, pus or fever
Fever and muscle aches followed by a cough or breathlessness 1–8 weeks after cleaning up rodent mess needs urgent medical care (hantavirus)
